26596-anna-the-adventuress.title: The Adventuress
26596-anna-the-adventuress.creator: Unknown
26596-anna-the-adventuress.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The girl paused and steadied herself for a moment against a field gate. Her breath came fast in little sobbing pants. Her dainty shoes were soiled with dust and there was a great tear in her skirt. Very slowly, very fearfully, she turned her head. Her cheeks were the colour of chalk, her eyes were filled with terror.

arxiv-1611-08542.title: Proposal for witnessing non-classical light with the human eye
arxiv-1611-08542.creator: A. Dodel, A. Mayinda, E. Oudot, A. Martin, P. Sekatski, J.-D. Bancal, N. Sangouard
arxiv-1611-08542.description: Abstract We give a complete proposal showing how to detect the non-classical nature of photonic states with naked eyes as detectors. The enabling technology is a sub-Poissonian photonic state that is obtained from single photons, displacement operations in phase space and basic non-photon-number-resolving detectors.

arxiv-1708-02099.title: Multimodal Classification for Analysing Social Media
arxiv-1708-02099.creator: Chi Thang Duong and Remi Lebret and Karl Aberer
arxiv-1708-02099.description: Abstract Classification of social media data is an important approach in understanding user behavior on the Web. Although information on social media can be of different modalities such as texts, images, audio or videos, traditional approaches in classification usually leverage only one prominent modality.

arxiv-2101-05089.title: Preparation and study of the entanglement of the Schrödinger cat state on the ibmq-melbourne quantum computer
arxiv-2101-05089.creator: A.R. Kuzmak, V.M. Tkachuk
arxiv-2101-05089.description: Abstract We study the entanglement between a certain qubit and the remaining system in the Schrödinger cat state prepared on the ibmq-melbourne quantum computer. The protocol, which we use for this purpose, is based on the determination of the mean value of spin corresponding to a certain qubit.

arxiv-2202-13631.title: Koszul property of Ulrich bundles and rationality of moduli spaces of stable bundles on Del Pezzo surfaces Thanks: Corresponding author: Debaditya Raychaudhury, email id: rcdeba@gmail.com
arxiv-2202-13631.creator: Purnaprajna Bangere, Jayan Mukherjee, Debaditya Raychaudhury
arxiv-2202-13631.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Purnaprajna Bangere, Jayan Mukherjee, Debaditya Raychaudhury. Let ℰ \mathcal{E} be a vector bundle on a smooth projective variety X ⊆ ℙ N X\subseteq\mathbb{P}^{N} that is Ulrich with respect to the hyperplane section H H . In this article, we study the Koszul property of ℰ \mathcal{E} , the slope–semistability of the k k –th iterated syzygy bundle 𝒮 k ​ ( ℰ ) \mathcal{S}_{k}(\mathcal{E}) for all k ≥ 0 k\geq 0 and rationality of moduli spaces of slope–stable bundles on Del Pezzo surfaces.

arxiv-2203-12949.title: Duality-Induced Regularizer for Semantic Matching Knowledge Graph Embeddings Thanks: J. Wang, Z. Zhang, Z. Shi, J. Cai, F. Wu are with: a) CAS Key Laboratory of Technology in GIPAS, University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei 230027, China; b) Institute of Artificial Intelligence, Hefei Com
arxiv-2203-12949.creator: Jie Wang, Senior Member, IEEE, Zhanqiu Zhang, Zhihao Shi, Jianyu Cai
arxiv-2203-12949.description: Abstract Semantic matching models—which assume that entities with similar semantics have similar embeddings—have shown great power in knowledge graph embeddings (KGE). Many existing semantic matching models use inner products in embedding spaces to measure the plausibility of triples and quadruples in static and temporal knowledge graphs.

arxiv-2210-16567.title: DeFIX: Detecting and Fixing Failure Scenarios with Reinforcement Learning in Imitation Learning Based Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2210-16567.creator: Resul Dagdanov, Feyza Eksen, Halil Durmus, Ferhat Yurdakul, Nazim Kemal Ure
arxiv-2210-16567.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Resul Dagdanov, Feyza Eksen, Halil Durmus, Ferhat Yurdakul, Nazim Kemal Ure. Safely navigating through an urban environment without violating any traffic rules is a crucial performance target for reliable autonomous driving. In this paper, we present a Reinforcement Learning (RL) based methodology to DEtect and FIX (DeFIX) failures of an Imitation Learning (IL) agent by extracting infraction spots and re-constructing mini-scenarios on these infraction areas to train an RL agent for fixing the shortcomings of the IL approach.

arxiv-2401-04199.title: Uniform distribution of polynomially-defined additive function to varying moduli
arxiv-2401-04199.creator: Agbolade Akande
arxiv-2401-04199.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Agbolade Akande. 1 Introduction Let q be a positive integer and f be an integer-valued arithmetic function. We say f is uniformly distributed modulo q if for every residue class a\ (\mathrm{mod}\ q) \displaystyle\#\{n\leq x:f(n)\equiv a\ (\mathrm{mod}\ q)\}\sim\frac{x}{q} \displaystyle\text{as $x\rightarrow\infty$}.

arxiv-2402-00453.title: Instruction Makes a Difference
arxiv-2402-00453.creator: Tosin Adewumi, Nudrat Habib, Lama Alkhaled, Elisa Barney
arxiv-2402-00453.description: Abstract We introduce the Instruction Document Visual Question Answering (iDocVQA) dataset and the Large Language Document (LLaDoc) model, for training Language-Vision (LV) models for document analysis and predictions on document images, respectively. Usually, deep neural networks for the DocVQA task are trained on datasets lacking instructions. We show that using instruction-following datasets improves performance.

arxiv-2411-08192.title: Accurate Electron-phonon Interactions from Advanced Density Functional Theory
arxiv-2411-08192.creator: Yanyong Wang, Manuel Engel, Christopher Lane, Henrique Miranda, Lin Hou, Bernardo Barbiellini, Robert S. Markiewicz, Jian-Xin Zhu, Georg Kresse, Arun Bansil, Jianwei Sun, Ruiqi Zhang
arxiv-2411-08192.description: Abstract Electron-phonon coupling (EPC) is key for understanding many properties of materials such as superconductivity and electric resistivity. Although first principles density-functional-theory (DFT) based EPC calculations are used widely, their efficacy is limited by the accuracy and efficiency of the underlying exchange-correlation functionals.

arxiv-2502-16976.title: Task-Oriented 6-DoF Grasp Pose Detection in Clutters
arxiv-2502-16976.creator: An-Lan Wang, Nuo Chen, Kun-Yu Lin, Yuan-Ming Li, Wei-Shi Zheng
arxiv-2502-16976.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by An-Lan Wang, Nuo Chen, Kun-Yu Lin, Yuan-Ming Li, Wei-Shi Zheng. In general, humans would grasp an object differently for different tasks, e.g., “grasping the handle of a knife to cut” vs. “grasping the blade to hand over”. In the field of robotic grasp pose detection research, some existing works consider this task-oriented grasping and made some progress, but they are generally constrained by low-DoF gripper type or non-cluttered setting, which is not applicable for human assistance in real life.

arxiv-2503-00945.title: Cross Modality Medical Image Synthesis for Improving Liver Segmentation
arxiv-2503-00945.creator: Muhammad Rafiq, Hazrat Ali, Ghulam Mujtaba, Zubair Shah, Shoaib Azmat
arxiv-2503-00945.description: Abstract Deep learning-based computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) of medical images requires large datasets. However, the lack of large publicly available labeled datasets limits the development of deep learning-based CAD systems. Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), in particular, CycleGAN, can be used to generate new cross-domain images without paired training data.

arxiv-2506-00027.title: From Mathematical Reasoning to Code: Generalization of Process Reward Models in Test-Time Scaling
arxiv-2506-00027.creator: Zhengyu Chen, Yudong Wang, Teng Xiao, Ruochen Zhou, Xuesheng Yang, Wei Wang, Zhifang Sui, Jingang Wang
arxiv-2506-00027.description: Abstract Recent advancements in improving the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models have underscored the efficacy of Process Reward Models (PRMs) in addressing intermediate errors through structured feedback mechanisms. This study analyzes PRMs from multiple perspectives, including training methodologies, scalability, and generalization capabilities.

arxiv-2507-06327.title: Enhanced Andreev Reflection in Flat-Band Systems: Wave Packet Dynamics, DC Transport and the Josephson Effect
arxiv-2507-06327.creator: Sarbajit Mazumdar, Anamitra Mukherjee, Kush Saha, Sourin Das
arxiv-2507-06327.description: Abstract We investigate Andreev reflection (AR) in a proximity-induced normal-superconductor (NS) junction within the extended α − 𝒯 3 \alpha-\mathcal{T}_{3} lattice, emphasizing the impact of flat bands on AR. Our findings reveal that flat bands significantly enhance AR. Through wave packet dynamics, we track the real-time evolution of quasi-particle wave packets across the junction, providing deeper insight into electron-hole conversion.

arxiv-2602-11224.title: Agent-Diff: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Enterprise API Tasks via Code Execution with State-Diff-Based Evaluation ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06 CCS: Computing methodologies CCS: Computing methodologies Artificial intelligence CCS: Computing methodologies Modelling and simulation
arxiv-2602-11224.creator: Hubert M. Pysklo, Artem Zhuravel, Patrick D. Watson
arxiv-2602-11224.description: Abstract . We present Agent-Diff, a novel benchmarking framework for evaluating agentic Large Language Models (LLMs) on real-world tasks that execute code via external APIs. Agentic LLM performance varies due to differences in models, external tool access, prompt structures, and agentic frameworks.

pmc-10565534.creator: Ahyoung Lee, Soondool Chung
pmc-10565534.description: 보이는 대표적인 집단이다. 한국지능정보사회진흥원의 2021 디지털 정보격차 실태조사 보고서에 따르면 우리나라 만 55세 이상 고령층의 모바일 스마트 기기 보유율은 81.6%에 달하고 있지만, 고령층의 디지털 정보화 역량 수준은 2021년 비고령층의 53.9%에 머무르고 있으며 디지털 정보화 활용 수준도 72.3%에 머무르고 있다[3]. 고령층 중에서도 특히 여성은 디지털 소외를 겪는 대표적인 집단이라고 할 수 있다[2].

pmc-10695932.title: The association between homocysteine and bacterial vaginosis: results from NHANES 2001–2004
pmc-10695932.creator: Jing Luo, Tong Chen, Yue Chen, Ze-Min Huang, Xiu-Juan Li, Hao-Kai Chen, Yi-Qi Huang, Xu-Guang Guo
pmc-10695932.description: Although no study has directly shown the relationship between bacterial vaginosis (BV) and homocysteine (HCY), we still found some association between these two through extensive literature and data analysis. BV score was calculated by Nugent’s method, less than equal to 6 is negative and greater than equal to 7 is positive.

pmc-11518980.title: Impact of breast milk on cortical pain response in newborns during the heel prick procedure: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-11518980.creator: Ozgul Bulut, Seyma Cagla Topaloglu, Nurgul Bulut, Meryem Hocaoglu, Sertac Arslanoglu
pmc-11518980.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the effects of breast milk on cortical pain response and behavioral response in newborns during heel-prick procedure.Study designA prospective, randomized controlled trial was conducted on healty-term newborns, undergoing heel blood sampling. Infants were randomly assigned to study group with receive orally 2 ml breast milk (n = 45) or a control group with no intervention (n = 45).

pmc-11709593.title: Unraveling the interplay between tau seeding and autophagy processes
pmc-11709593.creator: Annika Deckert, Annett Böddrich, Lisa Diez, Matthias Jürgen Schmitt, Juan Carlos Company Nevado, Stephanie Beetz, Lydia Brusendorf, Michela Serresi, Susanne Wegmann, Gaetano Gargiulo, Erich Wanker
pmc-11709593.description: BackgroundThe microtubule‐associated protein tau is the most commonly misfolded protein in neurodegenerative disorders including Alzheimer’s disease and other related tauopathies. These neurological illnesses are hypothesized to share a common mechanism of disease progression, where pathogenic aggregates or ‘seeds’ of the tau protein function as templates promoting misfolding of functional, soluble tau protein.

pmc-13233544.title: Real-time IVUS-guided retrieval of a coronary retained guidewire fragment: A case report
pmc-13233544.creator: Augustin Tchassem Dimdie, Moncef Al Barajraji, Georges H. Mairesse, David Dechaux, Pierre-Emmanuel Massart, Laurent Jamart
pmc-13233544.description: Percutaneous coronary intervention is generally safe, but rare complications such as guidewire fracture can occur and may lead to thrombosis, embolism, vessel injury, or myocardial ischemia. We report the case of a 58-year-old male patient with 2-vessel coronary artery disease who underwent coronary stenting of the left anterior descending and circumflex arteries in another institution.

pmc-13345032.title: Clinical Implementation and Accuracy Evaluation of a Novel Intrafraction Cone-beam Computed Tomography Technique for Stereotactic Radiosurgery and Radiotherapy
pmc-13345032.creator: Deeksha Jaiswal, Monika Goyal, C. P. Bhatt
pmc-13345032.description: Purpose:To evaluate the clinical implementation and setup accuracy of real-time intrafraction cone-beam computed tomography imaging during stereotactic radiosurgery and stereotactic radiotherapy.Materials and Methods:Ten patients treated with intracranial SRS/SRT were retrospectively analyzed. All patients were immobilized using the Fraxion stereotactic head system and treated with volumetric-modulated arc therapy (VMAT) on a linear accelerator (Elekta Versa HD).
